scenarios.context: A mother asks her son to tidy his room.

speakerA.en: Your room is a mess, Ali. Please clean it up before dinner.
Don't forget to throw away the old papers on your desk.
Keep it, but put it in the box under your bed. And take out the rubbish on your way down.
Yes, and open the window to let some fresh air in.

speakerB.en: Okay. I'll put away my clothes and hang up my jacket.
Can I keep this drawing? I don't want to throw it away.
Sure. Should I dust the desk as well?
All done in ten minutes. Can we eat now?

scenarios.context: A student asks a classmate for help after being absent.

speakerA.en: I was ill last week. How can I catch up with the lessons?
Thanks. Did the teacher hand out any worksheets?
Oh no. I'll never catch up!
Good idea. I'll sit down with her tomorrow and sort it out.

speakerB.en: Don't worry. I can lend you my notes. I copied down everything.
Yes, three. I'll bring them tomorrow. We also have to write up an experiment by Friday.
Yes, you will. If you fall behind, ask the teacher to go over the lesson again.
Great. Call me if you get stuck. I'll write down my number.

scenarios.context: Two students talk about joining a school club.

speakerA.en: Have you signed up for a club this term?
Look at the list on the notice board. You can sign up there.
Not at first. They lend out cameras, but you have to be careful with them.
Next Tuesday at four. Sign up today because places fill up fast.

speakerB.en: Not yet. I'm still trying to find out what's available.
Photography looks interesting. Do I need to bring my own camera?
Great. When do I have to show up for the first session?
Okay, I'll put my name down right now.

scenarios.context: A brother and sister are getting ready for the school bus.

speakerA.en: Hurry up, Nina! The bus leaves in ten minutes.
Look through your bag again. Maybe it slipped out.
Take your lunch box too, and lock up the door when you leave.
I'm coming. Come on, we need to speed up.

speakerB.en: I can't find my homework. Maybe I mixed it up with my sister's.
Found it! It was under my book. I just need to pack up my pencil case.
Okay. I'll run down and wait for you at the gate.
I'm sorry. I'll set my alarm earlier tomorrow.

scenarios.context: Two friends study together the evening before a test.

speakerA.en: I'm so worried about the test. I can't calm down.
I keep forgetting the dates. They're so hard to remember.
Okay. Please ask me the hardest ones first.
Thanks. I feel I'm calming down a bit.

speakerB.en: Take a deep breath. Let's go over the main points one more time.
Write them down on cards, and test yourself. I'll quiz you.
Sure. Don't give up if you get a few wrong. Just try again.
Good. Don't stay up late. Get some sleep, and you'll get through it tomorrow.
